author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Cemu 2.2: official stable release
summary: Cemu published 2.2 on September 8, 2024. The release record documents an official stable release for the Wii U emulator project.
searchKeywords: Wii U emulator release update changelog

blocks.text: The Cemu project published version 2.2 on September 8, 2024. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: Handle null timeout in nsysnet.select . Fixes a crash in Skylanders SuperChargers and Imaginators. Fixed an issue where changing the Receive untested updates option would have no effect. The Linux appimage version will use the system libstdc++.so.6 if it is newer than the bundled file. Updated French, Korean and Simplified Chinese translations.
